CW/数据模式用窄带滤波器，能显著提升弱信号可辨度。: Use narrow-band filters for CW and data modes; this markedly improves the discernibility of weak signals.
F = F₁ + (F₂−1)/G₁ + (F₃−1)/(G₁G₂) + …；前: F = F₁ + (F₂−1)/G₁ + (F₃−1)/(G₁G₂) + …; the higher the first-stage gain and the lower its noise figure, the better the overall result.
IP3 越高，强信号下互调产物越小。输入每升高 1dB，三阶互调产物升高 3dB: The higher the IP3, the smaller the intermodulation products under strong signals. For every 1 dB the input rises, third-order products rise by 3 dB;
MDS ≈ −174 + NF + 10·lg(B) + S/N_min（B 为: MDS ≈ −174 + NF + 10·lg(B) + S/N_min (B is the bandwidth in Hz).
Te = T₀·(F − 1)（T₀ = 290K），与噪声系数等价的另一种表述: Te = T₀·(F − 1) (T₀ = 290 K) — an equivalent expression to the noise figure; noise temperature is more convenient for cascade calculations.
下端是噪底 / MDS，上端是 1dB 压缩点或三阶截点 —— 两者之差才是动态: The lower end is the noise floor / MDS, the upper end the 1 dB compression point or third-order intercept — the difference between them is the dynamic range.
优先关注灵敏度、选择性、动态范围三项，而非只看发射功率。: Look first at sensitivity, selectivity and dynamic range, rather than only at transmit power.
典型 HF 接收机约 0.2 μV @50Ω（≈ −121 dBm）；同一灵敏度: A typical HF receiver: about 0.2 µV at 50 Ω (≈ −121 dBm); when stating the same sensitivity in dBm or µV the impedance must be given.
区分相邻频率信号的能力: The ability to separate signals on adjacent frequencies
取决于中频滤波器带宽与矩形系数。: Depends on the IF filter bandwidth and shape factor.
取决于前端滤波与 AGC 性能。: Depends on front-end filtering and AGC performance.
只提 P1dB / IP3 会漏掉「收窄带宽、降低 NF 同样能提高动态范围」这: Quoting only P1dB / IP3 misses the other half: narrowing the bandwidth and lowering the NF also improve dynamic range.
同时处理强信号与弱信号的能力: The ability to handle strong and weak signals at the same time
噪声底线升高约 10 dB，灵敏度相应变差。: the noise floor rises by about 10 dB and sensitivity worsens accordingly.
常温下约 -174 dBm/Hz，是接收灵敏度的物理极限。: About −174 dBm/Hz at room temperature — the physical limit of receiving sensitivity.
弱信号可开启前置放大器（preamp），但会降低动态范围。: For weak signals you can switch on the preamplifier, but it reduces dynamic range.
强邻道信号压制弱信号的现象: The phenomenon whereby a strong adjacent-channel signal suppresses a weak one
抑制镜像频率假响应的能力: The ability to suppress the spurious response at the image frequency
接收机自身引入的噪声（dB），越小越好。: The noise introduced by the receiver itself (dB); the smaller the better.
本地强干扰可加陷波器或适当衰减，保护前端不过载。: With strong local interference, add a notch filter or some attenuation to keep the front end out of overload.
由噪声系数与带宽共同决定，数值越小越灵敏。: Determined jointly by noise figure and bandwidth; the smaller the value the more sensitive.
由此得到 IIP3 ≈ Pin + IMD/2（IMD 为三阶产物相对单音的 d: hence IIP3 ≈ Pin + IMD/2 (IMD is the third-order product level in dBc relative to a single tone).
缺了 S/N_min 的式子算出来的是**噪声底**（0dB 信噪比），不是可辨: Without S/N_min the formula yields the noise floor (0 dB SNR), not the discernibility threshold;
能接收的最弱信号电平（dBm / μV）: The weakest signal level that can be received (dBm / µV)
衡量互调失真抑制能力: Measures the ability to suppress intermodulation distortion
超外差指标，二次变频可明显改善。: A superheterodyne specification; double conversion improves it markedly.
通常取 S/N_min ≈ 3dB，若按「10dB 信噪比灵敏度」口径还要再 +: S/N_min is usually taken as about 3 dB; if you use the "10 dB SNR sensitivity" convention, add a further 10 dB.
阻塞动态范围 ≈ P1dB − MDS；双音无杂散动态范围 ≈ (2/3)·(I: Blocking dynamic range ≈ P1dB − MDS; two-tone spurious-free dynamic range ≈ (2/3)·(IP3 − MDS).
